learned_rules.rule: used_for(X, measure) :- can_do(X, contain), can_do(X, pour)
can_do(X, contain) :- can_go_in(X, oven), has_property(X, heat_resistant)
has_property(X, heat_resistant) :- can_do(X, contain), can_go_in(X, oven)
made_of(X, metal) :- can_do(X, cut), has_property(X, sharp)
can_do(X, cut) :- not can_go_in(X, dishwasher), made_of(X, metal)
can_go_in(X, hob) :- not can_go_in(X, dishwasher), made_of(X, metal)
has_property(X, sharp) :- not can_go_in(X, dishwasher), made_of(X, metal)
made_of(X, metal) :- can_go_in(X, hob), used_for(X, heat)
used_for(X, heat) :- not can_go_in(X, dishwasher), made_of(X, metal)
can_do(X, wipe) :- can_do(X, soak_up), has_property(X, absorbent)
not can_go_in(X, oven) :- can_do(X, contain), made_of(X, plastic)
made_of(X, plastic) :- can_do(X, contain), not can_go_in(X, oven)
